== Notes ==
* Every time this enchantment is refreshed, the duration is affected by enchantment extending modifications on your equipment.
* Unlike [[Seed of Life]] and [["There's Nothing to Fear!"]], this can still be useful for secondary Assassins, as long as you are running a weapon build and have enough enchantment extending effects and/or critical strike chance to reliably maintain it.
** Consider using with an [[of the Assassin]] weapon upgrade to reduce the number of critical hits you need to maintain it.
